label: Base case and step case
subgoals: Check the base case as BMC to depth k - 1
Assume P on k consecutive states in the step case
Find a path of k P-states followed by a not-P state, or show none exists

label: Computing the minimal k
subgoals: Mark the P-states that have a successor outside P
Find the longest path of P-states ending at a marked state
Add 1 to its number of states to get the minimal k

label: Cycles and the simple-path constraint
subgoals: Detect a cycle of P-states that can reach a marked state
Add the pairwise-distinct constraint to the step case
Find the longest loop-free P-path ending at a marked state and add 1
